summaries.name: Kyoto
summaries.summary: Kyoto is a Japanese city with major attractions including Fushimi Inari Shrine (thousands of vermilion torii gates), Kinkaku-ji Temple (Golden Pavilion), Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Kiyomizu-dera Temple, the Gion geisha district (Hanami-koji Street), Nijo Castle, Philosopher's Path, Ginkaku-ji Temple (Silver Pavilion), Sanjusangendo Temple (1,001 Kannon statues), and Nishiki Market. The user visited Fushimi Inari Shrine during a two-week solo trip to Japan a few months before May 26, 2023, and stayed in budget hostels and guesthouses. Budget accommodation options include guesthouses like Guesthouse Kiyomizu (from ¥2,500/night), hostels like Nijo Guest House (from ¥2,000/night for a dorm bed), and capsule hotels like Nine Hours Kyoto (from ¥2,000/night). Nearby onsen options include Kurama Onsen (¥2,500), Yunessun (¥2,500), Funaoka Onsen (¥400), Tenzan no Yu (¥1,000), and Kawaramachi Onsen (¥400); the user visited a mountain onsen during their trip and enjoyed it.

summaries.name: Airbnb
summaries.summary: Airbnb can be used to rent an apartment or room in Kyoto, with prices starting from around ¥2,000 (about $18 USD) per night depending on location and amenities.

summaries.name: Bibimbap
summaries.summary: Bibimbap is a Korean mixed rice bowl dish with an assortment of vegetables, meat (usually beef), and a fried egg, recommended as a must-try dish in Seoul.

summaries.name: Jeyuk bokkeum
summaries.summary: Jeyuk bokkeum is a Korean stir-fried pork dish with vegetables and kimchi, served with rice, recommended as a must-try dish in Seoul.

summaries.name: Mandu
summaries.summary: Mandu are Korean dumplings that can be steamed, fried, or boiled, filled with meat, kimchi, or tofu, recommended as a must-try dish in Seoul.

summaries.name: Imjingak Peace Bell
summaries.summary: The Imjingak Peace Bell is a symbol of peace and unity between North and South Korea, located in the DMZ area near the Korean border, visited as part of the Imjingak Tour along with the Third Tunnel and Dora Observatory.

summaries.name: Freedom Bridge
summaries.summary: Freedom Bridge is located in the Imjingak area of the DMZ between North and South Korea, visited as part of the Imjingak Tour.
